---
title: "Available Studies"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
```

The table lists every study in the release this version of the package reads
(see `cmdRelease()`), with the number of samples the release holds and, where
the study has curated metadata in `harmonized_meta`, its PMID, body sites and
conditions. Studies named by a BioProject accession are processed but not yet
curated.

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
rel <- cmdRelease()
studies <- cmgdr::cmgd_studies(rel)

curated <- harmonized_meta |>
    dplyr::group_by(Study = study_name) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
        PMID = stringr::str_c(sort(unique(na.omit(pmid))), collapse = ", "),
        `Body Site` = stringr::str_c(sort(unique(na.omit(body_site))), collapse = ", "),
        Condition = stringr::str_c(sort(unique(na.omit(target_condition))), collapse = ", "),
        `Curated Samples` = dplyr::n()
    )

studies |>
    dplyr::rename(Study = study_name, `Samples in Release` = n_samples) |>
    dplyr::left_join(curated, by = "Study") |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
        c(PMID, `Body Site`, Condition),
        ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, "")
    )) |>
    dplyr::mutate(`Curated Samples` = tidyr::replace_na(`Curated Samples`, 0L)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Study) |>
    DT::datatable(options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100), extensions = "Responsive")
```
